# IoT Swapatron 5000

> A proposed free outdoor swap box for IoT and electronics parts in Fishers, Indiana. Take a part, leave a part. It is an open source community project in the planning stage. Nothing is decided and nothing is built yet. Treat every design, rule, and date as a proposal.

The full briefing for AI assistants is AGENTS.md in the repository. Read it before helping someone contribute.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Fishers-Founders-United/Swapatron5000/blob/main/AGENTS.md): briefing for AI assistants, including what not to do
- [README](https://github.com/Fishers-Founders-United/Swapatron5000/blob/main/README.md): the front door for people
- [DECISIONS.md](https://github.com/Fishers-Founders-United/Swapatron5000/blob/main/DECISIONS.md): every open question and how decisions are made
- [ROADMAP.md](https://github.com/Fishers-Founders-United/Swapatron5000/blob/main/ROADMAP.md): the proposed timeline

## How to help

- [How to have your say](https://github.com/Fishers-Founders-United/Swapatron5000/blob/main/docs/have-your-say.md): commenting and voting for people new to GitHub
- [CHALLENGES.md](https://github.com/Fishers-Founders-United/Swapatron5000/blob/main/CHALLENGES.md): known reasons it might not work. Doubts are treated as challenges to overcome
- [ASKS.md](https://github.com/Fishers-Founders-United/Swapatron5000/blob/main/ASKS.md): how people request parts and how others fill requests
- [VISION.md](https://github.com/Fishers-Founders-United/Swapatron5000/blob/main/VISION.md): the long-term dream, not a plan
- [BOUNTIES.md](https://github.com/Fishers-Founders-United/Swapatron5000/blob/main/BOUNTIES.md): jobs with points attached
- [Designs](https://github.com/Fishers-Founders-United/Swapatron5000/blob/main/hardware/designs/README.md): example drawing and how to contribute one
- [Wishlist](https://github.com/Fishers-Founders-United/Swapatron5000/blob/main/bom/BOM.csv): draft list of materials
